narrative:
Revenue assurance levers are worth GBP 94M a year — indexation, change requests, gainshare, volume true-ups and unbilled activity — against GBP 35.6M of KPI service credits, of which GBP 14M sits on the Civil Service Pension Scheme.

Wage inflation recovery is the gap: only 62% of the April 2026 National Living Wage and employer NICs increase is passed through. Change requests delivered before signature delay about GBP 6M of billing by 3.5 months.

signals.title: Delivery wage inflation only partly recovered
signals.excerpt: About £6M of the April 2026 National Living Wage and employer NICs increase is unrecovered; 62% passes through indexation clauses.

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.
